title: [Master] - Slice 626292: [Excise Tax][VENDOR] Bonded Locations for Excise Calculations
summary: Excise tax calculation now handles bonded-location scenarios for suspended-duty transfers, with logic that determines when transfers from bonded to non-bonded locations are subject to excise tax.
key_points: Added bonded-location treatment enum with Suspend/Ignore options for excise calculations
Implemented per-entry-type bonded eligibility rules: inbound to bonded excluded, outbound from bonded included, transfer shipment taxed only when released from bonded to non-bonded
Improved transfer shipment destination resolution to reliably identify transfer-to location in posted scenarios
Added comprehensive automated tests using real posted data flows for bonded scenarios
